title: feat(ambopp): equal n on ambiguous neighbors forbids every local-in-n pick
science: The #6646 obstruction promoted to its own theorem with the quantifier mechanized, not a probe cell: the runner builds the kernel-indexed domain and enumerates EVERY map f: n -> {+,-}, showing the two local-in-n completions are exactly the same-label fillings (+,+,-,0,0,+) and (-,-,-,0,0,+), while both firing completions carry opposite letters on +-x; hence N_same_label_fire = 0.
